messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense without making unsupported claims?

### Short answer
To compare our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense without unsupported claims, we need traceable evidence for four things: our exact product configuration and warranted specs, the Aerospace / Defense use case being claimed, the competitor’s exact product configuration and official specs, and a side-by-side test method or source that directly supports each comparison point. [3][54][61][70][7][12]
### Evidence required
| Evidence needed | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| Our Signal Generator datasheet, configuration guide, option stack, order numbers, and spec conditions for the exact configuration being compared | SMW200A specs and configuration guide are the proper sources for RF/baseband performance, interfaces, environmental data, ordering information, mandatory configuration, compatibility, retrofitting notes, recommended extras, and service notes. [1] | Current SMW200A pages say formal quotation/configuration still requires checking the official PDF, latest ordering information, and configure tool. [61] |
| Our Signal Analyzer datasheet, option stack, and spec conditions for the exact configuration being compared | FSW specs define the high-end signal/spectrum analyzer family and its options such as analysis bandwidth, frequency range, and other hardware options. [5][6][66] | Current FSW pages say the markdown is lossy and full options/footnotes must be checked in the PDF before quotation. [70] |
| Warranted-vs-nonwarranted status for every numeric claim | SMW200A specifications with limits and specifications without limits are warranted, while n. trc., typ., nom., and meas. are not guaranteed. [3] | FSW similarly states specifications with limits and specifications without limits are warranted, while non-traceable specifications, typical data, nominal values, and measured values are not guaranteed. [54] |
| A direct Aerospace / Defense application link for the claimed use case | The RAW evidence only shows an Aerospace & Defense Test presentation context and separately lists “Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer,” without a detailed use case, model, option stack, or comparison. [97][99] | A stronger application link exists for satellite payload testing: R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A are positioned for complete payload testing, including group delay, linearity, NPR, modulation, OFDM, spurious, and signal quality. [51] |
| The exact Aerospace / Defense standard, test case, or qualification context | DO-160, MIL-STD-461, and MIL-STD-464 are mentioned in drone EMC/EME context, but the sources are not formal standards and cannot be used to infer complete limits, categories, waveforms, setups, or pass/fail criteria. [18][20][86] | For any claim tied to DO-160, MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, satellite payload qualification, or TVAC, the relevant official standard/test plan and its version are still required. [18][20][49] |
| Competitor official datasheet, configuration guide, release notes, support terms, and option list | Keysight-related battle-card descriptions are R&S battle-card views and need Keysight official or third-party verification; the battle card does not provide formal datasheets, document versions, order numbers, option codes, release status, or test conditions. [7] | Anritsu-related weakness claims also cannot be treated as official specs or market facts, and Anritsu frequency range, bandwidth, data rate, option code, software tools, and support model require Anritsu official datasheets/release notes/support terms. [12] |
| A competitor model that is actually in the same instrument class and use case | Current passages mention Keysight N9040B UXA as a spectrum analyzer and Keysight E8257D PSG as a signal generator in a Starlink user-terminal test-equipment mapping, but that mapping is deck-level and requires formal product specs, options, frequency range, uncertainty, and test method before use. [34] | Current passages do not provide a validated Aerospace / Defense competitor comparison against our SMW200A / FSW solution. [7][34][75] |
| A controlled side-by-side test method, measurement setup, uncertainty budget, and calibration conditions | Satellite group-delay pages state actual performance depends on DUT, frequency range, bandwidth, SNR, option, and calibration setup, and do not provide a complete uncertainty budget, test limits, standard chapter, or test case ID. [96] | TVAC pages likewise state the source is solution-level and not a product qualification certificate, and it lacks pressure, temperature profile, dwell time, calibration interval, and uncertainty budget. [22] |
| Evidence for any market-share, ecosystem, customer, or superiority claim | Keysight pages explicitly do not infer market share, customers, shipment volume, or adoption status, and ecosystem/market-dominance claims in the battle card lack traceable external evidence. [7][75] | R&S superiority, only-vendor, and lower-TCO statements in battle-card-style sources are sales positioning, not directly citable technical specifications. [12] |
### Minimum evidence pack before making the comparison
1. R&S SMW200A official specifications and configuration guide for the proposed generator configuration, including frequency option, baseband module, modulation bandwidth, fading/channel-emulation options if claimed, and all mandatory/compatibility notes. [1][57][65]  
2. R&S FSW official specifications for the proposed analyzer model and options, including frequency range, analysis-bandwidth option, real-time or I/Q options if claimed, and applicability restrictions by model. [6][66][69]  
3. A documented Aerospace / Defense test scenario that directly uses signal generation and signal analysis, such as satellite payload complete testing with FSW + SMW200A, or a formal EMC/EME standard/test plan when the claim is about drone or airborne equipment testing. [51][86]  
4. Competitor official datasheets/configuration guides/release notes for the exact competing signal generator and signal analyzer models, because current Keysight and Anritsu battle-card information is not official competitor evidence. [7][12]  
5. A side-by-side comparison table limited to parameters that both sides document under comparable conditions, because SMW200A and FSW distinguish warranted specifications from typical, nominal, measured, and non-guaranteed data. [3][54]  
6. Test setup evidence, calibration evidence, and uncertainty information for performance claims, because the satellite and TVAC sources do not provide complete uncertainty budgets or qualification-level test procedures. [22][96]  
### What we cannot claim from the current passages alone
We cannot claim that our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution is better than a competitor for Aerospace / Defense, because the current competitor passages either rely on R&S battle-card descriptions needing external validation or only list deck-level equipment mappings without formal competitor specs and test conditions. [7][34][75]  
We cannot claim a formal Aerospace / Defense qualification fit from the DO-160 or military drone passages, because those pages are not formal standard summaries and cannot be used to determine complete categories, limits, waveforms, setups, pass/fail criteria, or required test items. [18][20]

- 來源：[[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]。

- 文件性質：產品 specifications；記錄 RF/baseband performance、interfaces、environmental data、ordering information 與 options。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S SMW200A › 規格適用條件與語彙
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）：

- Product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 下 storage `3 hours` 後 warm-up operation `30 minutes`、符合 specified environmental conditions、遵守 recommended calibration interval、完成所有 applicable internal automatic adjustments。
- Specifications with limits 與 specifications without limits 代表 warranted product performance。
- `n. trc.`、`typ.`、`nom.`、`meas.` 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
- Uncertainties 的 coverage factor 為 `2`，依 GUM 計算。
- 依 3GPP standard，本文件中的 `Gbps`、`Mcps`、`Mbps`、`Msps`、`kbps`、`ksps`、`Msample/s` 不是 SI units。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的優點
- 可在 milliseconds 內量測 wideband signals 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。
- Signal averaging 與 smoothing 可改善 carrier-to-noise ratio，在 cables 與 fixtures 導致 high signal path losses 時取得 valid results。
- 可自動補償 in-orbit measurements 的 Doppler effects。
- Frequency converters 的 relative group delay 可達 1 ns measurement accuracy，且不需要 reference mixer 或 golden device。
- Non-frequency-translating measurements 的 relative group delay 可達 300 ps measurement accuracy。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可內部彈性產生 MCCW signals 與 modulated signals，並可設定 carrier spacing 與 number of carriers。
- Deembedding function 可修正 measurement setup 中 cables 與 fixtures 的 frequency response。
- [[R&S FSW-K17S]] option 可量測 low SNR 的 wideband signals，透過分析 overall signal 的 subspans 改善 SNR 與 measurement speeds。

- Test load、filter、coupler、RF interference signal generator。

Starlink User Terminal › Recommended RF test equipment
[[Starlink UT Test Flow]] 推薦：

- Spectrum analyzer：[[R&S FSW]]（43.5 GHz、POI 0.46 µs）、Keysight N9040B UXA。
- Signal generator：[[R&S SMW200A]]（100 kHz–31.8 GHz）、Keysight E8257D PSG。
- Power meter：[[R&S NRX]] with NRP33S（±2.5 dB abs）、Bird 43 wattmeter。
- VNA：Keysight PNA-X（67 GHz）、[[R&S ZNA]] for array calibration。
- Satellite simulator：Terma Ku/Ka-band for loopback EIRP / G/T testing。

這些是該 deck 的推薦清單；正式頻率範圍、POI、功率不確定度、option 需求與 order number 必須回查各產品 datasheet。

Starlink User Terminal › Phased array evolution
[[Starlink UT Test Flow]] 以 beamformer impact 比較三個版本：

| 版本 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| V1 Circular | 79 DBFs、1,264 elements、motors、NF 3–4 dB |
| Rev3 Gen2 | 16 Shiraz、1,536 elements、NF 2.5–3 dB |
| Rev4 Gen3 | 6 Shiraz daisy-chain、1,536 elements、NF 2–2.5 dB、110° FOV |

來源另稱 Rev4 gains：

- Jitter 9 ms vs 112 ms Rev3。
- Down 307 Mbps。
- Power efficiency +50%。

這些數字連到 [[相控陣列天線]] 與 [[Beamforming]] 主題，但來源未提供 teardown、FCC filing、SpaceX 官方文件或第三方測試報告。

Starlink User Terminal › Regulatory / certification 語境
來源提到：

- FCC USA：Part 15 WLAN router、Part 25 NGSO satellite、SAR / MPE testing。
- Taiwan NCC：Fixed satellite service compliance、Ku-band uplink overlap review。
- Labs：[[Bureau Veritas]] Taoyuan、local R&S / Keysight partnerships for emissions。
- Key limits：EIRP density、PFD at ground、interference mitigation、beacon power。
- Timeline：DVT certification 3–6 months、PVT production ramp post-approval。

⚠️ [[Starlink UT Test Flow]]（2026-09-18 raw converted）說 NCC/FCC certification: Taiwan labs，且 Labs: Bureau Veritas (Taoyuan), local R&S/Keysight partnerships for emissions；但既有頁面 [[NCC]] 說 NCC 在衛星 / 通訊監理語境應連到 [[國家通訊傳播委員會]]，不是測試實驗室。判斷：本來源可能把監理機關、認證流程與實驗室混寫；在取得 NCC 公告或 Bureau Veritas scope 前，不把 NCC 寫成 lab。

SDR-assisted UAV security › Jamming detection
[[Software-Defined_Radio_Deployments_in_UAV-Driven_Applications_A_Comprehensive_Review]] 摘錄多項 jamming detection 研究：

- [55] 使用 [[Holy Stone HS720E]]、[[Ettus USRP B210]] 與 [[GNU Radio]]，研究 barrage、protocol-aware、single-tone、successive-pulse jamming attacks。Spectrogram-based CNN model 達到 99.79% accuracy 與 0.03% false alarm rate。
- [56] [[BloodHound]] 使用 [[Ettus X310]] SDR units 與 raw I/Q samples，在 mobile environments 中 early detect / identify jamming；來源稱 detection accuracy 超過 99%。
- [57] [[BloodHound+]] 使用 sparse autoencoders 分析 I/Q grayscale images；在 RJP=0.5、receiver distance=10 m 時 classification accuracy 達 99.7%。

SDR-assisted UAV security › GPS spoofing / jamming detection
來源指出 affordable SDR devices，如 [[HackRF One]]、[[BladeRF 2.0]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，可用於 GNSS spoofing / jamming attacks，也可用於測試 defense mechanisms：

- [62] 提出 lightweight LSTM-based detection model，並以 knowledge distillation 壓縮，利於整合進 UAV control systems。
- [63] 研究 [[HackRF One]] 1.0 與 external TCXO 對 GNSS signal spoofing / jamming threats 的影響；受測 UAV GNSS receivers 包含 3DR IRIS+、Tarot 650 v2.2、DJI Inspire、Sky Hunter。
- [64] [[MAVIDS]] 使用 PCA 與 one-class classifiers，並以 [[HackRF One]]、[[GPS-SDR-SIM]] 與 [[GNU Radio Companion]] 進行 GPS spoofing / jamming experiments；macro-averaged F1 scores 為 GPS spoofing 90.57%、jamming 94.3%。
- [66] 使用 cellular BS 與 Wi-Fi AP crowd-sourced information 進行 GPS spoofing detection / mitigation，並以 [[HackRF One]] + TCXO 產生 spoofing signals。

SDR-assisted UAV security › unresolved
- 各 jamming / spoofing research 的法規授權、測試場地許可與 safety controls 未在本次摘要中完整展開。
- 來源沒有把 SDR-assisted security solutions 對應到商用產品 maturity level。
- [[HackRF One]]、[[BladeRF x40]]、[[Ettus USRP X310]] 等 device 在不同研究中的配置、firmware、clocking、antenna 與 calibration 條件需逐篇回查。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]]：提供 satellite payload and components test and measurement solutions。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co KG]]：文件頁尾 copyright owner，© 2017–2022，地址標示 81671 Munich, Germany。
- [[R&S FSW]]：用於 group delay、linearity、NPR、signal quality、spurious、carrier-in-carrier 與 oscillator / synthesizer measurements；來源列 key features 為 up to 90 GHz、up to 500 GHz with external harmonic mixers、up to 8.3 GHz internal analysis bandwidth、800 MHz real-time analysis bandwidth。
- [[R&S SMW200A]]：用於 multi-carrier / modulated signal generation、OFDM waveform generation、DPD、NPR stimulus；來源列 key features 為 up to 67 GHz、up to 2 GHz I/Q modulation bandwidth、with [[R&S SMW-K555]] 可達 4 GHz signal bandwidth、optional second RF path up to 44 GHz。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：用於 payload components RF measurements、converter / mixer group delay、noise figure、amplifier/filter/antenna measurements；來源列 key features 包含 up to 67 GHz、up to eight independent receivers、four phase coherent sources、two internal LO sources、internal combiner。
- [[R&S FS-SNS]]：smart noise source，用於簡化 spectrum analyzer 的 noise figure and gain measurements。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]：TVAC-compatible automatic calibration unit，可放在 chamber 內做 inline recalibration。
- [[R&S NRP33SN-V]] 與 [[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：TVAC-designed three-path diode power sensors，分別支援 up to 33 GHz / 67 GHz。
- [[R&S RTP]]、[[R&S RTO6]]：oscilloscopes，用於 satellite digital interface trigger、decode 與 debug。
- [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]：本來源的總題目。
- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：比較 spectrum analyzer + signal generator 與 VNA two-tone technique 的測試主題。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下 satellite payload qualification 測試主題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]]、[[Group delay]]、[[NPR]]、[[EVM]]、[[OFDM]]、[[Spurious emissions]]、[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 Rohde & Schwarz application brochure《Satellite payload and components testing》，文件代碼 `PD 5215.2120.92`，Version 02.00，文件日期標示 `September 2022 (ch)`，主題是使用 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 儀器測試 [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]、transponders、modules 與 components。

- 衛星通訊系統支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems，並要求 24/7 reliable operation 與 multi-decade system longevity。
- 來源將 payload 技術演進描述為從 bent-pipe 或 digital transparent payloads 進展到 digital regenerative payloads；regenerative payloads 增加 system capacity 與 flexibility，但也增加 testing complexity。
- Bent-pipe payload channel 高階組成包含 uplink antenna、low noise amplifier、filter、frequency converter、filter、high power amplifier、filter、downlink antenna 與 local oscillator。
- Regenerative payload channel 在 RF chain 中加入 digital demodulator、baseband processing and switching、digital modulator 等功能區塊。
- 來源定位 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S ZNA]] 為 satellite payload / component RF testing 的核心儀器：[[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 偏 complete payload testing，[[R&S ZNA]] 偏 component level testing。
- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]] 是主要測試主題之一；來源比較 multi-carrier group delay measurement 與 [[R&S ZNA]] two-tone technique。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements 涵蓋 gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、NPR、ACLR、DPD 與 EVM 等 payload / component characterization。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 使用 chamber 外部測試儀器、長 cables、inline calibration modules 與 TVAC-compatible power sensors，以處理 temperature drift 與 vacuum 下無法人工進入 chamber 的 calibration 問題。
- Digital interface testing 涵蓋 [[SpaceWire]]、8b/10b-based [[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus trigger/decode/debug 測試。

衛星酬載與元件測試
[[衛星酬載與元件測試]]是針對 satellite transponders、payload subsystems、modules 與 RF / digital components 的設計、開發、驗證與 qualification 測試集合，來源以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 儀器方案為主。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 儀器與測試角色
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]]：建議用於 complete payload testing，涵蓋 group delay、linearity、NPR、modulation、OFDM、spurious 與 signal quality。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：建議用於 component level testing，特別是 converters、mixers、amplifiers、filters、antennas、noise figure、group delay 與 phase measurements。
- [[R&S RTP]] 與 [[R&S RTO6]]：用於 satellite digital interface decode / trigger / debug。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：用於 [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 的 inline calibration 與 chamber 內 power measurement。

FSW_specs_en_5215-6749-22_v1701 › 產品資料與規格標示規則
- Specifications with limits 代表 warranted product performance。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）依同樣方式指定與測試，但因缺少可 traceable to national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits 代表 warranted product performance，通常為指定值無偏差或偏差可忽略的參數。
- Typical data（typ.）為代表性資訊；標 range 時表示 production time 約 80% instruments 可達成。
- Nominal values（nom.）不做 statistical evaluation，production 時不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）是 individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100 › 主要配置與相依關係
- RF path A 必須安裝一個 `R&S®SMW-B10xx` frequency option。
- RF path B 若安裝 `R&S®SMW-B20xx` frequency option，baseband main module 必須是 `R&S®SMW-B13T` 或 `R&S®SMW-B13XT`。
- 必須安裝 `R&S®SMW-B13`、`R&S®SMW-B13T` 或 `R&S®SMW-B13XT` 其中一個 signal routing and baseband main module。
- `R&S®SMW-B13` 與 `R&S®SMW-B13T` 不能安裝於配備 `R&S®SMW-B1044O`、`R&S®SMW-B2044O`、`R&S®SMW-B1056O` 或 `R&S®SMW-B1067O` frequency options 的儀器。
- `R&S®SMW-B1044` 只能與 `R&S®SMW-B2044` 組合；`R&S®SMW-B1044N` 只能與 `R&S®SMW-B2044N` 組合；`R&S®SMW-B1044O` 只能與 `R&S®SMW-B2044O` 組合。
- `R&S®SMW-B94L` 是 deeper chassis，Order No. `1438.8150.02`；來源明列 required and only possible for `2 × 12.75 GHz`、`2 × 31.8 GHz`、`2 × 44 GHz` RF path combinations。
- 所有已安裝 RF paths 必須具有相同 phase noise performance level；RF path A 的 `R&S®SMW-B709/-B710/-B711` 分別對應 RF path B 的 `R&S®SMW-B719/-B720/-B721`。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › 來源中的 DO-160 定位
[[2025RS Drone Solution]] 說 [[RTCA DO-160]] is important because it provides the minimum operational performance standards for electronic systems and equipment that support aviation to pursue increased safety, system capacity and efficiency。

來源另說其 purpose 是提供 means of determining performance characteristics of airborne equipment in environmental conditions which may be encountered in airborne operation of the equipment，並可與 applicable standards 一起作為 minimum specification。

使用限制：來源未提供 DO-160 的正式版次文件、section limit table、category matrix 或適用 drone 類型。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 20 — Radio Frequency Susceptibility
來源說此測試確保 EUT exposed to a level of RF modulated power 時不受影響，並分為：

- Conducted Susceptibility（low freq）。
- Radiated Susceptibility（high freq）。

來源說 emissions can come from equipment installed inside aircraft as well as external radiators such as radar stations；Conducted Susceptibility similar to [[CS114]] test，Radiated Susceptibility similar to [[RS103]]。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing
[[DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing]] 是 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 中引用 [[RTCA DO-160]] 作為 airborne equipment environmental conditions and test procedures 的測試線索，用於 military / aviation drone EMC proposal context。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 15 — Magnetic Effect
來源說 Section 15 concern 為 equipment magnetic effect，目標是 finding or proving the closest distance to compasses or compass sensors（flux gates）at which that unit is allowed to be installed。

### Short answer
To compare our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense without unsupported claims, we need traceable evidence for four things: our exact product configuration and warranted specs, the Aerospace / Defense use case being claimed, the competitor’s exact product configuration and official specs, and a side-by-side test method or source that directly supports each comparison point. [3][54][61][70][7][12]
### Evidence required
| Evidence needed | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| Our Signal Generator datasheet, configuration guide, option stack, order numbers, and spec conditions for the exact configuration being compared | SMW200A specs and configuration guide are the proper sources for RF/baseband performance, interfaces, environmental data, ordering information, mandatory configuration, compatibility, retrofitting notes, recommended extras, and service notes. [1] | Current SMW200A pages say formal quotation/configuration still requires checking the official PDF, latest ordering information, and configure tool. [61] |
| Our Signal Analyzer datasheet, option stack, and spec conditions for the exact configuration being compared | FSW specs define the high-end signal/spectrum analyzer family and its options such as analysis bandwidth, frequency range, and other hardware options. [5][6][66] | Current FSW pages say the markdown is lossy and full options/footnotes must be checked in the PDF before quotation. [70] |
| Warranted-vs-nonwarranted status for every numeric claim | SMW200A specifications with limits and specifications without limits are warranted, while n. trc., typ., nom., and meas. are not guaranteed. [3] | FSW similarly states specifications with limits and specifications without limits are warranted, while non-traceable specifications, typical data, nominal values, and measured values are not guaranteed. [54] |
| A direct Aerospace / Defense application link for the claimed use case | The RAW evidence only shows an Aerospace & Defense Test presentation context and separately lists “Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer,” without a detailed use case, model, option stack, or comparison. [97][99] | A stronger application link exists for satellite payload testing: R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A are positioned for complete payload testing, including group delay, linearity, NPR, modulation, OFDM, spurious, and signal quality. [51] |
| The exact Aerospace / Defense standard, test case, or qualification context | DO-160, MIL-STD-461, and MIL-STD-464 are mentioned in drone EMC/EME context, but the sources are not formal standards and cannot be used to infer complete limits, categories, waveforms, setups, or pass/fail criteria. [18][20][86] | For any claim tied to DO-160, MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, satellite payload qualification, or TVAC, the relevant official standard/test plan and its version are still required. [18][20][49] |
| Competitor official datasheet, configuration guide, release notes, support terms, and option list | Keysight-related battle-card descriptions are R&S battle-card views and need Keysight official or third-party verification; the battle card does not provide formal datasheets, document versions, order numbers, option codes, release status, or test conditions. [7] | Anritsu-related weakness claims also cannot be treated as official specs or market facts, and Anritsu frequency range, bandwidth, data rate, option code, software tools, and support model require Anritsu official datasheets/release notes/support terms. [12] |
| A competitor model that is actually in the same instrument class and use case | Current passages mention Keysight N9040B UXA as a spectrum analyzer and Keysight E8257D PSG as a signal generator in a Starlink user-terminal test-equipment mapping, but that mapping is deck-level and requires formal product specs, options, frequency range, uncertainty, and test method before use. [34] | Current passages do not provide a validated Aerospace / Defense competitor comparison against our SMW200A / FSW solution. [7][34][75] |
| A controlled side-by-side test method, measurement setup, uncertainty budget, and calibration conditions | Satellite group-delay pages state actual performance depends on DUT, frequency range, bandwidth, SNR, option, and calibration setup, and do not provide a complete uncertainty budget, test limits, standard chapter, or test case ID. [96] | TVAC pages likewise state the source is solution-level and not a product qualification certificate, and it lacks pressure, temperature profile, dwell time, calibration interval, and uncertainty budget. [22] |
| Evidence for any market-share, ecosystem, customer, or superiority claim | Keysight pages explicitly do not infer market share, customers, shipment volume, or adoption status, and ecosystem/market-dominance claims in the battle card lack traceable external evidence. [7][75] | R&S superiority, only-vendor, and lower-TCO statements in battle-card-style sources are sales positioning, not directly citable technical specifications. [12] |
### Minimum evidence pack before making the comparison
1. R&S SMW200A official specifications and configuration guide for the proposed generator configuration, including frequency option, baseband module, modulation bandwidth, fading/channel-emulation options if claimed, and all mandatory/compatibility notes. [1][57][65]  
2. R&S FSW official specifications for the proposed analyzer model and options, including frequency range, analysis-bandwidth option, real-time or I/Q options if claimed, and applicability restrictions by model. [6][66][69]  
3. A documented Aerospace / Defense test scenario that directly uses signal generation and signal analysis, such as satellite payload complete testing with FSW + SMW200A, or a formal EMC/EME standard/test plan when the claim is about drone or airborne equipment testing. [51][86]  
4. Competitor official datasheets/configuration guides/release notes for the exact competing signal generator and signal analyzer models, because current Keysight and Anritsu battle-card information is not official competitor evidence. [7][12]  
5. A side-by-side comparison table limited to parameters that both sides document under comparable conditions, because SMW200A and FSW distinguish warranted specifications from typical, nominal, measured, and non-guaranteed data. [3][54]  
6. Test setup evidence, calibration evidence, and uncertainty information for performance claims, because the satellite and TVAC sources do not provide complete uncertainty budgets or qualification-level test procedures. [22][96]  
### What we cannot claim from the current passages alone
We cannot claim that our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution is better than a competitor for Aerospace / Defense, because the current competitor passages either rely on R&S battle-card descriptions needing external validation or only list deck-level equipment mappings without formal competitor specs and test conditions. [7][34][75]  
We cannot claim a formal Aerospace / Defense qualification fit from the DO-160 or military drone passages, because those pages are not formal standard summaries and cannot be used to determine complete categories, limits, waveforms, setups, pass/fail criteria, or required test items. [18][20]

FSW_specs_en_5215-6749-22_v1701 › 產品資料與規格標示規則
- Specifications with limits 代表 warranted product performance。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）依同樣方式指定與測試，但因缺少可 traceable to national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits 代表 warranted product performance，通常為指定值無偏差或偏差可忽略的參數。
- Typical data（typ.）為代表性資訊；標 range 時表示 production time 約 80% instruments 可達成。
- Nominal values（nom.）不做 statistical evaluation，production 時不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）是 individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
